intent: Compute the mean ChIP-seq signal over each gene: genes.bed holds the genes and signal.bedGraph is the coverage track (the value is the 4th column). Output the gene record followed by its mean signal, tab separated.
silent_error: bedmap's numeric operations (--mean, --sum, --min, --max, ...) read the SCORE of the map file, which is its 5th column. A bedGraph has four columns (the value is in column 4) and bedmap only notices this under the optional --ec check ('Only 4 columns given. Require at least 5'). Without it, it runs on and returns 0.000000 for the first overlapped gene and NAN for the rest, although the same call with --count shows that 3, 2 and 2 track intervals overlap them. The table looks like a quiet, low-signal ChIP sample (zeros and NANs) with exit 0 and an empty stderr. The BEDOPS manual defines the score operations on the fifth column of the mapping file, so a bedGraph has to be reshaped to BED5 before it is mapped.
